sentences.text: Dated this the 27th day of February, 2025  ORDER
This is in continuation of the earlier interim order passed by this Court on 05.12.2024.

The petitioners in W.P.(C).
No.28334/2024, who are the wholesale fish dealers, pointed out that the area earmarked for them is only five cents which is not sufficient for their activities.

2. In response to the same, the learned Standing Counsel for the Municipality brought the attention of this Court to the sketch produced along with a memo filed on 13.02.2025, wherein, on the northwestern side of the plot, an area has been earmarked for conducting the auctioning of fish.

Even though the learned Standing Counsel admits that, the area shown therein is only 5 cents, it shall be open for the said petitioners to utilize the area lying on the southern side of the said plot, for the activities of the said petitioners, which according to the WP(C) No.28334/2024 3/6 Order Date :
27-02-2025 W.P.C Nos. 28334, 28652 & 28842 of 2024 and 5736 of 2025 learned Standing Counsel comes to around 35 cents.
This submission is recorded.

3. As far as the petitioner in W.P.(C) No.28842/2024 is concerned, the grievance highlighted by the petitioner therein is that, the Municipality did not furnish the details of the facilities which will be provided to him when he is shifting to the new premises.

4. In response to the same, the learned Standing Counsel pointed out, by referring to the sketch referred to above that, on the northern and eastern sides of the earmarked property, there are buildings in existence which will be allotted to the petitioner and the similarly situated persons.
It is further submitted by the learned Standing Counsel that, all the said buildings will be allotted with room numbers to enable the petitioner/allottees to get the electricity connection.
The facility for water shall also be made by the municipality.
The said submissions are also recorded.

5. It is also submitted by the learned Standing Counsel that, as per the byelaw prepared by the Municipality, a copy of WP(C) No.28334/2024 4/6 Order Date : 27-02-2025 W.P.C Nos. 28334,
28652 & 28842 of 2024 and 5736 of 2025 which is produced along with a memo filed on 13.02.2025, the modalities for providing the facilities are mentioned and the same shall be strictly followed while implementing the same.
6.
Another apprehension of the petitioners is with regard to the access to the heavy vehicles.
It is submitted in this regard by the learned Standing Counsel that the way leading to the earmarked property, now available is having a width of 16.85 meters.
This submission is also recorded.

Further steps in the implementation of the order dated 05.12.2024 shall be taken by the Municipality, and necessary cooperation for the same shall be made by the petitioners subject to the compliance of the above directions.

The petitioners shall vacate the premises now occupied by them, within a period of Subin Dominic vs Aluva Municipality on 27 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25331673/
2 two weeks, provided that the Municipality is offering the facilities as referred to above.
